messages.subject: plot_profile
parts:
First of all, thanks very much for providing “tidyLPA” package in R. I am using this package to do a latent profile analysis.

 I have 12 variables, and after using `compare_solutions’ I got Model 2 with 7 profiles is associated with lowest BIC. However, when I plot profiles (using plot_profiles) I got following waning message ( related to palette colors).

 Warning message:

In RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n, pal) :

  n too large, allowed maximum for palette Set1 is 9

Returning the palette you asked for with that many colors

 My question is, is there any way to increase allowed maximum palette?

Thanks and regards,

Akram
